skill_name: Research and explain the differences between Hyperledger Fabric and Ethereum?
workflow: Hyperledger Fabric and Ethereum are two of the most prominent blockchain platforms. Hyperledger Fabric is a permissioned blockchain platform developed by the Linux Foundation. It is designed for enterprise use cases and focuses on privacy, scalability, and performance. The platform utilizes Ledger APIs, smart contracts, and consensus models.
